```pddl
; Domain File: child-snack.pddl
(define (domain child-snack)
  (:requirements :typing :equality)
  (:types child bread-portion content-portion sandwich tray place)
  (:constants kitchen - place)

  (:predicates
    (at ?t - tray ?p - place)
    (at_kitchen_bread ?b - bread-portion)
    (at_kitchen_content ?c - content-portion)
    (no_gluten_bread ?b - bread-portion)
    (no_gluten_content ?c - content-portion)
    (allergic_gluten ?c - child)
    (not_allergic_gluten ?c - child)
    (waiting ?c - child ?p - place)
    (served ?c - child)
    (notexist ?s - sandwich)
    (exist ?s - sandwich)
    (is_gluten_free ?s - sandwich)
    (is_regular ?s - sandwich)
    (in_kitchen ?s - sandwich)
    (on_tray ?s - sandwich ?t - tray)
  )

  (:action make_sandwich_no_gluten
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?b - bread-portion ?c - content-portion)
    :precondition (and
      (notexist ?s)
      (at_kitchen_bread ?b)
      (no_gluten_bread ?b)
      (at_kitchen_content ?c)
      (no_gluten_content ?c)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (at_kitchen_bread ?b))
      (not (at_kitchen_content ?c))
      (not (notexist ?s))
      (exist ?s)
      (is_gluten_free ?s)
      (in_kitchen ?s)
    )
  )

  (:action make_sandwich
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?b - bread-portion ?c - content-portion)
    :precondition (and
      (notexist ?s)
      (at_kitchen_bread ?b)
      (not (no_gluten_bread ?b)) ; Regular bread
      (at_kitchen_content ?c)
      (not (no_gluten_content ?c)) ; Regular content
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (at_kitchen_bread ?b))
      (not (at_kitchen_content ?c))
      (not (notexist ?s))
      (exist ?s)
      (is_regular ?s)
      (in_kitchen ?s)
    )
  )

  (:action put_on_tray
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?t - tray)
    :precondition (and
      (in_kitchen ?s)
      (at ?t kitchen)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (in_kitchen ?s))
      (on_tray ?s ?t)
    )
  )

  (:action serve_sandwich_no_gluten
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?c - child ?t - tray ?p - place)
    :precondition (and
      (allergic_gluten ?c)
      (waiting ?c ?p)
      (on_tray ?s ?t)
      (at ?t ?p)
      (is_gluten_free ?s)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (on_tray ?s ?t))
      (served ?c)
      (not (waiting ?c ?p))
    )
  )

  (:action serve_sandwich
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?c - child ?t - tray ?p - place)
    :precondition (and
      (not_allergic_gluten ?c)
      (waiting ?c ?p)
      (on_tray ?s ?t)
      (at ?t ?p)
      (is_regular ?s)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (on_tray ?s ?t))
      (served ?c)
      (not (waiting ?c ?p))
    )
  )

  (:action move_tray
    :parameters (?t - tray ?p1 ?p2 - place)
    :precondition (and
      (at ?t ?p1)
      (not (= ?p1 ?p2)) ; Ensure the tray actually moves to a different place
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (at ?t ?p1))
      (at ?t ?p2)
    )
  )
)
```

```pddl
(define (domain child-snack)
  (:requirements :typing :equality)
  (:types child bread-portion content-portion sandwich tray place)
  (:constants kitchen - place)

  (:predicates
    (at_kitchen_bread ?b - bread-portion)
    (at_kitchen_content ?c - content-portion)
    (at_kitchen_sandwich ?s - sandwich) ; Sandwich made, waiting to be put on tray
    (no_gluten_bread ?b - bread-portion)
    (no_gluten_content ?c - content-portion)
    (no_gluten_sandwich ?s - sandwich) ; Indicates a specific sandwich is gluten-free
    (notexist ?s - sandwich) ; Used to model sandwich creation; initially true, becomes false after making
    (on_tray ?s - sandwich ?t - tray) ; Sandwich is on a tray
    (at ?t - tray ?p - place) ; Tray location
    (allergic_gluten ?c - child)
    (not_allergic_gluten ?c - child)
    (waiting ?c - child ?p - place) ; Child is waiting at a place
    (served ?c - child) ; Child has been served
  )

  (:action make_sandwich_no_gluten
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?b - bread-portion ?c - content-portion)
    :precondition (and
                    (at_kitchen_bread ?b)
                    (at_kitchen_content ?c)
                    (no_gluten_bread ?b)
                    (no_gluten_content ?c)
                    (notexist ?s)
                  )
    :effect (and
              (not (at_kitchen_bread ?b))
              (not (at_kitchen_content ?c))
              (at_kitchen_sandwich ?s)
              (no_gluten_sandwich ?s)
              (not (notexist ?s))
            )
  )

  (:action make_sandwich
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?b - bread-portion ?c - content-portion)
    :precondition (and
                    (at_kitchen_bread ?b)
                    (at_kitchen_content ?c)
                    (notexist ?s)
                    ; To ensure regular sandwiches consume regular ingredients if available
                    ; and not gluten-free ones, one might add:
                    ; (or (not (no_gluten_bread ?b)) (not (no_gluten_content ?c)))
                    ; However, the problem description implies a 'regular' sandwich
                    ; simply doesn't get the 'no_gluten_sandwich' tag, regardless of ingredients.
                    ; So, we omit this for simplicity and direct interpretation.
                  )
    :effect (and
              (not (at_kitchen_bread ?b))
              (not (at_kitchen_content ?c))
              (at_kitchen_sandwich ?s)
              (not (notexist ?s))
              ; IMPORTANT: This sandwich is NOT guaranteed gluten-free,
              ; so we do NOT add (no_gluten_sandwich ?s) here.
            )
  )

  (:action put_on_tray
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?t - tray)
    :precondition (and
                    (at_kitchen_sandwich ?s)
                    (at ?t kitchen) ; Tray must be in the kitchen to put sandwiches on it
                  )
    :effect (and
              (not (at_kitchen_sandwich ?s))
              (on_tray ?s ?t)
            )
  )

  (:action serve_sandwich_no_gluten
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?c - child ?t - tray ?p - place)
    :precondition (and
                    (allergic_gluten ?c)
                    (waiting ?c ?p)
                    (on_tray ?s ?t)
                    (at ?t ?p)
                    (no_gluten_sandwich ?s) ; Must be a gluten-free sandwich
                  )
    :effect (and
              (not (on_tray ?s ?t))
              (served ?c)
              (not (waiting ?c ?p)) ; Child is no longer waiting
            )
  )

  (:action serve_sandwich
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?c - child ?t - tray ?p - place)
    :precondition (and
                    (not_allergic_gluten ?c)
                    (waiting ?c ?p)
                    (on_tray ?s ?t)
                    (at ?t ?p)
                    ; This action serves a regular sandwich.
                    ; It can be either a sandwich made by `make_sandwich` (which lacks `no_gluten_sandwich`),
                    ; or a `no_gluten_sandwich` if desired, as it's safe for non-allergic children.
                    ; The key is it does NOT require `(no_gluten_sandwich ?s)`.
                  )
    :effect (and
              (not (on_tray ?s ?t))
              (served ?c)
              (not (waiting ?c ?p)) ; Child is no longer waiting
            )
  )

  (:action move_tray
    :parameters (?t - tray ?p1 ?p2 - place)
    :precondition (at ?t ?p1)
    :effect (and
              (not (at ?t ?p1))
              (at ?t ?p2)
            )
  )
)
```

```pddl
(define (domain child-snack)
  (:requirements :typing :equality)
  (:types child bread-portion content-portion sandwich tray place)
  (:constants kitchen - place)

  (:predicates
    (at_kitchen_bread ?b - bread-portion)
    (at_kitchen_content ?c - content-portion)
    (no_gluten_bread ?b - bread-portion)
    (no_gluten_content ?c - content-portion)
    (notexist ?s - sandwich)
    (at_kitchen_sandwich ?s - sandwich)
    (is_no_gluten ?s - sandwich) ; This sandwich is gluten-free
    (is_regular ?s - sandwich)   ; This sandwich may contain gluten
    (on_tray ?s - sandwich ?t - tray)
    (at ?t - tray ?p - place)
    (allergic_gluten ?c - child)
    (not_allergic_gluten ?c - child)
    (waiting ?c - child ?p - place)
    (served ?c - child)
  )

  (:action make_sandwich_no_gluten
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?b - bread-portion ?c - content-portion)
    :precondition (and
      (at_kitchen_bread ?b)
      (no_gluten_bread ?b)
      (at_kitchen_content ?c)
      (no_gluten_content ?c)
      (notexist ?s)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (at_kitchen_bread ?b))
      (not (at_kitchen_content ?c))
      (at_kitchen_sandwich ?s)
      (is_no_gluten ?s)
      (not (notexist ?s))
    )
  )

  (:action make_sandwich
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?b - bread-portion ?c - content-portion)
    :precondition (and
      (at_kitchen_bread ?b)
      (not (no_gluten_bread ?b)) ; Ensure it's not gluten-free bread
      (at_kitchen_content ?c)
      (not (no_gluten_content ?c)) ; Ensure it's not gluten-free content
      (notexist ?s)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (at_kitchen_bread ?b))
      (not (at_kitchen_content ?c))
      (at_kitchen_sandwich ?s)
      (is_regular ?s)
      (not (notexist ?s))
    )
  )

  (:action put_on_tray
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?t - tray)
    :precondition (and
      (at_kitchen_sandwich ?s)
      (at ?t kitchen)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (at_kitchen_sandwich ?s))
      (on_tray ?s ?t)
    )
  )

  (:action serve_sandwich_no_gluten
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?c - child ?t - tray ?p - place)
    :precondition (and
      (allergic_gluten ?c)
      (waiting ?c ?p)
      (is_no_gluten ?s)
      (on_tray ?s ?t)
      (at ?t ?p)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (on_tray ?s ?t))
      (served ?c)
      (not (waiting ?c ?p))
    )
  )

  (:action serve_sandwich
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?c - child ?t - tray ?p - place)
    :precondition (and
      (not_allergic_gluten ?c)
      (waiting ?c ?p)
      (is_regular ?s)
      (on_tray ?s ?t)
      (at ?t ?p)
    )
    :effect (and

      (served ?c)
      (not (waiting ?c ?p))

      (at ?t ?p2)
```

```pddl
(define (domain child-snack)
  (:requirements :typing :equality)
  (:types child bread-portion content-portion sandwich tray place)
  (:constants kitchen - place)

  (:predicates
    (at_kitchen_bread ?b - bread-portion)
    (at_kitchen_content ?c - content-portion)
    (no_gluten_bread ?b - bread-portion)
    (no_gluten_content ?c - content-portion)
    (notexist ?s - sandwich) ; True if sandwich has not been made yet
    (at_kitchen_sandwich ?s - sandwich) ; True if sandwich has been made and is in the kitchen
    (is_gluten_free_sandwich ?s - sandwich) ; True if the sandwich is gluten-free
    (at ?t - tray ?p - place) ; Location of a tray
    (on_tray ?s - sandwich ?t - tray) ; Sandwich is on a specific tray
    (allergic_gluten ?c - child) ; Child is allergic to gluten
    (not_allergic_gluten ?c - child) ; Child is not allergic to gluten
    (waiting ?c - child ?p - place) ; Child is waiting at a specific place
    (served ?c - child) ; Child has been served a sandwich
  )

  (:action make_sandwich_no_gluten
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?b - bread-portion ?c - content-portion)
    :precondition (and
      (at_kitchen_bread ?b)
      (no_gluten_bread ?b)
      (at_kitchen_content ?c)
      (no_gluten_content ?c)
      (notexist ?s)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (at_kitchen_bread ?b))
      (not (at_kitchen_content ?c))
      (not (notexist ?s))
      (at_kitchen_sandwich ?s)
      (is_gluten_free_sandwich ?s)
    )
  )

  (:action make_sandwich
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?b - bread-portion ?c - content-portion)
    :precondition (and
      (at_kitchen_bread ?b)
      (at_kitchen_content ?c)
      (not (no_gluten_bread ?b)) ; Ensure bread is not gluten-free
      (not (no_gluten_content ?c)) ; Ensure content is not gluten-free
      (notexist ?s)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (at_kitchen_bread ?b))
      (not (at_kitchen_content ?c))
      (not (notexist ?s))
      (at_kitchen_sandwich ?s)
      (not (is_gluten_free_sandwich ?s)) ; Explicitly mark as not gluten-free
    )
  )

  (:action put_on_tray
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?t - tray)
    :precondition (and
      (at_kitchen_sandwich ?s)
      (at ?t kitchen)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (at_kitchen_sandwich ?s))
      (on_tray ?s ?t)
    )
  )

  (:action serve_sandwich_no_gluten
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?c - child ?t - tray ?p - place)
    :precondition (and
      (allergic_gluten ?c)
      (waiting ?c ?p)
      (on_tray ?s ?t)
      (at ?t ?p)
      (is_gluten_free_sandwich ?s)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (on_tray ?s ?t))
      (not (waiting ?c ?p))
      (served ?c)
    )
  )

  (:action serve_sandwich
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?c - child ?t - tray ?p - place)
    :precondition (and
      (not_allergic_gluten ?c)
      (waiting ?c ?p)
      (on_tray ?s ?t)
      (at ?t ?p)
      (not (is_gluten_free_sandwich ?s)) ; Must be a regular (non-GF) sandwich
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (on_tray ?s ?t))
      (not (waiting ?c ?p))
      (served ?c)
    )
  )

  (:action move_tray
    :parameters (?t - tray ?p1 ?p2 - place)
    :precondition (and
      (at ?t ?p1)
      (not (= ?p1 ?p2)) ; Tray must move to a different place
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (at ?t ?p1))
      (at ?t ?p2)
    )
  )
```

```pddl
(define (domain child-snack)
  (:requirements :typing :equality)
  (:types child bread-portion content-portion sandwich tray place)
  (:constants kitchen - place)

  (:predicates
    (no_gluten_bread ?b - bread-portion)
    (no_gluten_content ?c - content-portion)
    (at_kitchen_bread ?b - bread-portion)
    (at_kitchen_content ?c - content-portion)
    (notexist ?s - sandwich) ; indicates sandwich hasn't been made yet
    (at_kitchen_sandwich ?s - sandwich) ; sandwich is made and in the kitchen
    (no_gluten_sandwich ?s - sandwich) ; indicates a gluten-free sandwich
    (on_tray ?s - sandwich ?t - tray) ; sandwich is on a tray
    (at ?t - tray ?p - place) ; tray is at a specific place
    (allergic_gluten ?c - child)
    (not_allergic_gluten ?c - child)
    (waiting ?c - child ?p - place) ; child is waiting at a place
    (served ?c - child) ; child has been served
  )

  (:action make_sandwich_no_gluten
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?b - bread-portion ?c - content-portion)
    :precondition (and
      (at_kitchen_bread ?b)
      (at_kitchen_content ?c)
      (no_gluten_bread ?b)
      (no_gluten_content ?c)
      (notexist ?s)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (at_kitchen_bread ?b))
      (not (at_kitchen_content ?c))
      (not (notexist ?s))
      (at_kitchen_sandwich ?s)
      (no_gluten_sandwich ?s)
    )
  )

  (:action make_sandwich
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?b - bread-portion ?c - content-portion)
    :precondition (and
      (at_kitchen_bread ?b)
      (at_kitchen_content ?c)
      (notexist ?s)
      ; This action creates a regular sandwich. It can use any bread/content,
      ; but its output is NOT a no_gluten_sandwich.
      ; To prevent it from consuming ingredients meant for GF sandwiches when possible,
      ; one could add (or (not (no_gluten_bread ?b)) (not (no_gluten_content ?c)))
      ; but for simplicity, we let the planner figure out optimal ingredient use.
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (at_kitchen_bread ?b))
      (not (at_kitchen_content ?c))
      (not (notexist ?s))
      (at_kitchen_sandwich ?s)
      ; Importantly, this action does NOT assert (no_gluten_sandwich ?s)
    )
  )

  (:action put_on_tray
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?t - tray)
    :precondition (and
      (at_kitchen_sandwich ?s)
      (at ?t kitchen)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (at_kitchen_sandwich ?s))
      (on_tray ?s ?t)
    )
  )

  (:action serve_sandwich_no_gluten
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?c - child ?t - tray ?p - place)
    :precondition (and
      (allergic_gluten ?c)
      (waiting ?c ?p)
      (on_tray ?s ?t)
      (at ?t ?p)
      (no_gluten_sandwich ?s) ; Must be a gluten-free sandwich
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (on_tray ?s ?t))
      (not (waiting ?c ?p))
      (served ?c)
    )
  )

  (:action serve_sandwich
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?c - child ?t - tray ?p - place)
    :precondition (and
      (not_allergic_gluten ?c)
      (waiting ?c ?p)
      (on_tray ?s ?t)
      (at ?t ?p)
      (not (no_gluten_sandwich ?s)) ; Must NOT be a gluten-free sandwich (i.e., regular)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (on_tray ?s ?t))
      (not (waiting ?c ?p))
      (served ?c)
    )
  )

  (:action move_tray
    :parameters (?t - tray ?p1 ?p2 - place)
    :precondition (and
      (at ?t ?p1)
      (not (= ?p1 ?p2)) ; Tray cannot move to the same place
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (at ?t ?p1))
      (at ?t ?p2)
    )
  )
)
```

```pddl
(define (domain child-snack)
  (:requirements :typing :equality)
  (:types child bread-portion content-portion sandwich tray place)
  (:constants kitchen - place)

  (:predicates
    (at_kitchen_bread ?b - bread-portion)
    (at_kitchen_content ?c - content-portion)
    (no_gluten_bread ?b - bread-portion) ; True if a bread portion is gluten-free
    (no_gluten_content ?c - content-portion) ; True if a content portion is gluten-free
    (notexist ?s - sandwich) ; True if a sandwich has not been made yet
    (at_kitchen_sandwich ?s - sandwich) ; True if a sandwich is in the kitchen
    (no_gluten_sandwich ?s - sandwich) ; True if a sandwich is gluten-free
    (on_tray ?s - sandwich ?t - tray) ; True if a sandwich is on a specific tray
    (at ?t - tray ?p - place) ; True if a tray is at a specific place
    (allergic_gluten ?c - child) ; True if a child is allergic to gluten
    (not_allergic_gluten ?c - child) ; True if a child is not allergic to gluten
    (waiting ?c - child ?p - place) ; True if a child is waiting at a specific place
    (served ?c - child) ; True if a child has been served
  )

  (:action make_sandwich_no_gluten
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?b - bread-portion ?c - content-portion)
    :precondition (and
      (at_kitchen_bread ?b)
      (at_kitchen_content ?c)
      (no_gluten_bread ?b)
      (no_gluten_content ?c)
      (notexist ?s)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (at_kitchen_bread ?b))
      (not (at_kitchen_content ?c))
      (not (notexist ?s))
      (at_kitchen_sandwich ?s)
      (no_gluten_sandwich ?s)
    )
  )

  (:action make_sandwich
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?b - bread-portion ?c - content-portion)
    :precondition (and
      (at_kitchen_bread ?b)
      (at_kitchen_content ?c)
      (not (no_gluten_bread ?b)) ; Ensure non-gluten-free bread is used
      (not (no_gluten_content ?c)) ; Ensure non-gluten-free content is used
      (notexist ?s)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (at_kitchen_bread ?b))
      (not (at_kitchen_content ?c))
      (not (notexist ?s))
      (at_kitchen_sandwich ?s)
      ; This sandwich is not marked as (no_gluten_sandwich), indicating it's a regular one.
    )
  )

  (:action put_on_tray
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?t - tray)
    :precondition (and
      (at_kitchen_sandwich ?s)
      (at ?t kitchen)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (at_kitchen_sandwich ?s))
      (on_tray ?s ?t)
    )
  )

  (:action serve_sandwich_no_gluten
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?c - child ?t - tray ?p - place)
    :precondition (and
      (allergic_gluten ?c)
      (waiting ?c ?p)
      (no_gluten_sandwich ?s)
      (on_tray ?s ?t)
      (at ?t ?p)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (on_tray ?s ?t))
      (not (waiting ?c ?p))
      (served ?c)
    )
  )

  (:action serve_sandwich
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?c - child ?t - tray ?p - place)
    :precondition (and
      (not_allergic_gluten ?c)
      (waiting ?c ?p)
      (on_tray ?s ?t)
      (at ?t ?p)
      ; Regular children can be served any sandwich (regular or gluten-free).
      ; The exclusion of (allergic_gluten ?c) ensures they don't take the wrong sandwich type.
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (on_tray ?s ?t))
      (not (waiting ?c ?p))
      (served ?c)
    )
  )

  (:action move_tray
    :parameters (?t - tray ?p1 ?p2 - place)
    :precondition (and
      (at ?t ?p1)
      (not (= ?p1 ?p2)) ; The tray must move to a different place
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (at ?t ?p1))
      (at ?t ?p2)
    )
```

(define (domain child-snack)

```pddl
  (:types 
    child 
    bread-portion 
    content-portion 
    sandwich 
    tray 
    place
  )
  (:constants 
    kitchen - place
  )

  (:predicates
    (at ?t - tray ?p - place) ; Tray ?t is at place ?p
    (at_kitchen_bread ?b - bread-portion) ; Bread ?b is available in the kitchen
    (at_kitchen_content ?c - content-portion) ; Content ?c is available in the kitchen
    (at_kitchen_sandwich ?s - sandwich) ; Sandwich ?s has been made and is in the kitchen
    (on_tray ?s - sandwich ?t - tray) ; Sandwich ?s is on tray ?t
    (no_gluten_bread ?b - bread-portion) ; Bread ?b is gluten-free
    (no_gluten_content ?c - content-portion) ; Content ?c is gluten-free
    (is_gluten_free ?s - sandwich) ; Sandwich ?s is gluten-free
    (allergic_gluten ?c - child) ; Child ?c is allergic to gluten
    (not_allergic_gluten ?c - child) ; Child ?c is not allergic to gluten
    (waiting ?c - child ?p - place) ; Child ?c is waiting at place ?p
    (served ?c - child) ; Child ?c has been served
    (notexist ?s - sandwich) ; Sandwich ?s has not yet been made
  )

  (:action make_sandwich_no_gluten
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?b - bread-portion ?c - content-portion)
    :precondition (and
      (at_kitchen_bread ?b)
      (at_kitchen_content ?c)
      (no_gluten_bread ?b)
      (no_gluten_content ?c)
      (notexist ?s)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (at_kitchen_bread ?b))
      (not (at_kitchen_content ?c))
      (at_kitchen_sandwich ?s)
      (is_gluten_free ?s)
      (not (notexist ?s))
    )
  )

  (:action make_sandwich
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?b - bread-portion ?c - content-portion)
    :precondition (and
      (at_kitchen_bread ?b)
      (at_kitchen_content ?c)
      (not (no_gluten_bread ?b))   ; Ensure regular bread is used
      (not (no_gluten_content ?c)) ; Ensure regular content is used
      (notexist ?s)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (at_kitchen_bread ?b))
      (not (at_kitchen_content ?c))
      (at_kitchen_sandwich ?s)
      (not (notexist ?s))
      ; A regular sandwich is not gluten-free, so no (is_gluten_free ?s) is asserted
    )
  )

    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?t - tray)
    :precondition (and
      (at_kitchen_sandwich ?s)
      (at ?t kitchen) ; Tray must be in the kitchen to put a sandwich on it

    :effect (and
```

(define (domain child-snack)

```pddl
    (at_kitchen_bread ?b - bread-portion)
    (at_kitchen_content ?c - content-portion)
    (no_gluten_bread ?b - bread-portion)
    (no_gluten_content ?c - content-portion)
    (notexist ?s - sandwich) ; indicates sandwich has not been made yet
    (at_kitchen_sandwich ?s - sandwich) ; sandwich is made and in the kitchen
    (no_gluten_sandwich ?s - sandwich) ; indicates a gluten-free sandwich
    (on_tray ?s - sandwich ?t - tray)
    (at ?t - tray ?p - place) ; location of a tray
    (allergic_gluten ?c - child)
    (not_allergic_gluten ?c - child)
    (waiting ?c - child ?p - place) ; child is waiting at a place
    (served ?c - child) ; child has been served
  )

  (:action make_sandwich_no_gluten
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?b - bread-portion ?c - content-portion)
    :precondition (and
      (notexist ?s)
      (at_kitchen_bread ?b)
      (no_gluten_bread ?b)
      (at_kitchen_content ?c)
      (no_gluten_content ?c)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (at_kitchen_bread ?b))
      (not (at_kitchen_content ?c))
      (not (notexist ?s))
      (at_kitchen_sandwich ?s)
      (no_gluten_sandwich ?s)
    )
  )

  (:action make_sandwich
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?b - bread-portion ?c - content-portion)
    :precondition (and
      (notexist ?s)
      (at_kitchen_bread ?b)
      (at_kitchen_content ?c)
      (not (no_gluten_bread ?b)) ; bread is not gluten-free
      (not (no_gluten_content ?c)) ; content is not gluten-free
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (at_kitchen_bread ?b))
      (not (at_kitchen_content ?c))
      (not (notexist ?s))
      (at_kitchen_sandwich ?s)
      ; Regular sandwich implies it is not gluten-free, no explicit predicate needed if `no_gluten_sandwich` is for GF ones only
    )
  )

  (:action put_on_tray
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?t - tray)
    :precondition (and
      (at_kitchen_sandwich ?s)
      (at ?t kitchen)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (at_kitchen_sandwich ?s))
      (on_tray ?s ?t)
    )
  )

  (:action serve_sandwich_no_gluten
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?c - child ?t - tray ?p - place)

      (not (waiting ?c ?p))
```

```pddl
(define (domain child-snack)
  (:requirements :typing :equality)
  (:types child bread-portion content-portion sandwich tray place)
  (:constants kitchen - place)

  (:predicates
    (at_kitchen_bread ?b - bread-portion) ; A portion of bread is available in the kitchen
    (at_kitchen_content ?c - content-portion) ; A portion of content is available in the kitchen
    (no_gluten_bread ?b - bread-portion) ; This bread portion is gluten-free
    (no_gluten_content ?c - content-portion) ; This content portion is gluten-free
    (notexist ?s - sandwich) ; The sandwich has not been made yet
    (at_kitchen_sandwich ?s - sandwich) ; The sandwich has been made and is in the kitchen
    (no_gluten_sandwich ?s - sandwich) ; This sandwich is gluten-free
    (has_gluten_sandwich ?s - sandwich) ; This sandwich contains gluten
    (on_tray ?s - sandwich ?t - tray) ; A sandwich is placed on a tray
    (at ?t - tray ?p - place) ; A tray is currently at a specific place
    (allergic_gluten ?c - child) ; This child is allergic to gluten
    (not_allergic_gluten ?c - child) ; This child is not allergic to gluten
    (waiting ?c - child ?p - place) ; A child is waiting for food at a specific place
    (served ?c - child) ; A child has been served a sandwich
  )

  (:action make_sandwich_no_gluten
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?b - bread-portion ?c - content-portion)
    :precondition (and
      (at_kitchen_bread ?b)
      (no_gluten_bread ?b)
      (at_kitchen_content ?c)
      (no_gluten_content ?c)
      (notexist ?s)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (at_kitchen_bread ?b))
      (not (at_kitchen_content ?c))
      (not (notexist ?s))
      (at_kitchen_sandwich ?s)
      (no_gluten_sandwich ?s)
    )
  )

  (:action make_sandwich
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?b - bread-portion ?c - content-portion)
    :precondition (and
      (at_kitchen_bread ?b)
      (not (no_gluten_bread ?b)) ; This bread is NOT gluten-free
      (at_kitchen_content ?c)
      (not (no_gluten_content ?c)) ; This content is NOT gluten-free
      (notexist ?s)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (at_kitchen_bread ?b))
      (not (at_kitchen_content ?c))
      (not (notexist ?s))
      (at_kitchen_sandwich ?s)
      (has_gluten_sandwich ?s) ; Mark this sandwich as having gluten
    )
  )

  (:action put_on_tray
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?t - tray)
    :precondition (and
      (at_kitchen_sandwich ?s)
      (at ?t kitchen)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (at_kitchen_sandwich ?s))
      (on_tray ?s ?t)
    )
  )

  (:action serve_sandwich_no_gluten
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?c - child ?t - tray ?p - place)
    :precondition (and
      (allergic_gluten ?c)
      (waiting ?c ?p)
      (no_gluten_sandwich ?s)
      (on_tray ?s ?t)
      (at ?t ?p)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (on_tray ?s ?t))
      (not (waiting ?c ?p))
      (served ?c)
    )
  )

  (:action serve_sandwich
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?c - child ?t - tray ?p - place)
    :precondition (and
      (not_allergic_gluten ?c)
      (waiting ?c ?p)
      (on_tray ?s ?t)
      (at ?t ?p)
      ; A child who is not allergic to gluten can be served any sandwich (gluten-free or regular).
      ; Therefore, no predicate like (has_gluten_sandwich ?s) or (no_gluten_sandwich ?s) is required here,
      ; as long as it's a sandwich on a tray at the correct location.
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (on_tray ?s ?t))
      (not (waiting ?c ?p))
      (served ?c)
    )
  )

  (:action move_tray
    :parameters (?t - tray ?p1 ?p2 - place)
    :precondition (and
      (at ?t ?p1)
      (not (= ?p1 ?p2)) ; Tray cannot move to the same place
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (at ?t ?p1))
      (at ?t ?p2)
    )
  )
)
```

```pddl
    (at_kitchen_bread ?b - bread-portion)
    (at_kitchen_content ?c - content-portion)

    ;; Gluten-free properties of ingredients
    (no_gluten_bread ?b - bread-portion)
    (no_gluten_content ?c - content-portion)

    ;; State of a sandwich
    (notexist ?s - sandwich) ; True if sandwich has not yet been made
    (at_kitchen_sandwich ?s - sandwich) ; Sandwich is in the kitchen after creation
    (is_gluten_free_sandwich ?s - sandwich) ; Indicates a gluten-free sandwich

    ;; Sandwich on a tray
    (on_tray ?s - sandwich ?t - tray)

    ;; Location of a tray
    (at ?t - tray ?p - place)

    ;; Child properties and state
    (allergic_gluten ?c - child)
    (not_allergic_gluten ?c - child)
    (waiting ?c - child ?p - place) ; Child is waiting at a specific table
    (served ?c - child) ; Child has been served
  )

    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?b - bread-portion ?c - content-portion)
    :precondition (and 
      (at_kitchen_bread ?b)
      (at_kitchen_content ?c)
      (no_gluten_bread ?b)
      (no_gluten_content ?c)
      (notexist ?s)
    )

      (not (at_kitchen_content ?c))

      (at_kitchen_sandwich ?s)

      (notexist ?s)
    )
    :effect (and 
      (not (at_kitchen_bread ?b))
      (not (at_kitchen_content ?c))
      (not (notexist ?s))
      (at_kitchen_sandwich ?s)
      ;; This sandwich is not explicitly marked as gluten-free.
      ;; It implies it contains gluten or is not certified gluten-free.
    )
  )

    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?t - tray)
    :precondition (and 
      (at_kitchen_sandwich ?s)
      (at ?t kitchen) ; Tray must be in the kitchen to load sandwiches
    )
    :effect (and 
      (not (at_kitchen_sandwich ?s))
      (on_tray ?s ?t)
    )
  )

  (:action serve_sandwich_no_gluten
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?c - child ?t - tray ?p - place)
    :precondition (and 
      (allergic_gluten ?c)
      (waiting ?c ?p)
      (is_gluten_free_sandwich ?s)
      (on_tray ?s ?t)
      (at ?t ?p) ; Tray must be at the same place as the child

      (served ?c)
      (not (waiting ?c ?p))
    )

      (waiting ?c ?p)
      (on_tray ?s ?t)
      (at ?t ?p) ; Tray must be at the same place as the child
    )
    :effect (and

      (served ?c)
      (not (waiting ?c ?p))
```

```pddl
      (not (waiting ?c ?p))
```

```pddl
(define (domain child-snack)
  (:requirements :typing :equality)
  (:types child bread-portion content-portion sandwich tray place)
  (:constants kitchen - place)

  (:predicates
    (at_kitchen_bread ?b - bread-portion)
    (at_kitchen_content ?c - content-portion)
    (no_gluten_bread ?b - bread-portion)
    (no_gluten_content ?c - content-portion)
    (notexist ?s - sandwich) ; True if sandwich has not been made yet
    (at_kitchen_sandwich ?s - sandwich) ; True if sandwich has been made and is in the kitchen
    (no_gluten_sandwich ?s - sandwich) ; True if the sandwich is gluten-free
    (at ?t - tray ?p - place) ; Location of a tray
    (on_tray ?s - sandwich ?t - tray) ; A sandwich is on a specific tray
    (allergic_gluten ?c - child) ; Child is allergic to gluten
    (not_allergic_gluten ?c - child) ; Child is not allergic to gluten
    (waiting ?c - child ?p - place) ; Child is waiting at a specific place
    (served ?c - child) ; Child has been served
  )

  (:action make_sandwich_no_gluten
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?b - bread-portion ?c - content-portion)
    :precondition (and
      (at_kitchen_bread ?b)
      (at_kitchen_content ?c)
      (no_gluten_bread ?b)
      (no_gluten_content ?c)
      (notexist ?s)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (at_kitchen_bread ?b))
      (not (at_kitchen_content ?c))
      (not (notexist ?s))
      (at_kitchen_sandwich ?s)
      (no_gluten_sandwich ?s)
    )
  )

  (:action make_sandwich
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?b - bread-portion ?c - content-portion)
    :precondition (and
      (at_kitchen_bread ?b)
      (at_kitchen_content ?c)
      (notexist ?s)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (at_kitchen_bread ?b))
      (not (at_kitchen_content ?c))
      (not (notexist ?s))
      (at_kitchen_sandwich ?s)
      ; This sandwich is not certified as gluten-free.
      ; If it were, it would be made with make_sandwich_no_gluten.
      (not (no_gluten_sandwich ?s))
    )
  )

  (:action put_on_tray
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?t - tray)
    :precondition (and
      (at_kitchen_sandwich ?s)
      (at ?t kitchen)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (at_kitchen_sandwich ?s))
      (on_tray ?s ?t)
    )
  )

  (:action serve_sandwich_no_gluten
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?c - child ?t - tray ?p - place)
    :precondition (and
      (allergic_gluten ?c)
      (waiting ?c ?p)
      (no_gluten_sandwich ?s)
      (on_tray ?s ?t)
      (at ?t ?p)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (on_tray ?s ?t))
      (served ?c)
      (not (waiting ?c ?p)) ; Child is no longer waiting
    )
  )

  (:action serve_sandwich
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?c - child ?t - tray ?p - place)
    :precondition (and
      (not_allergic_gluten ?c)
      (waiting ?c ?p)
      (on_tray ?s ?t)
      (at ?t ?p)
      ; A non-allergic child can eat any sandwich, including a gluten-free one,
      ; but this action is typically for "regular" sandwiches or if a GF one
      ; is used for a non-allergic child. No specific exclusion of no_gluten_sandwich
      ; is needed here, as the goal is simply for the child to be served appropriately.
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (on_tray ?s ?t))
      (served ?c)
      (not (waiting ?c ?p)) ; Child is no longer waiting
    )
  )

  (:action move_tray
    :parameters (?t - tray ?p1 ?p2 - place)
    :precondition (at ?t ?p1)
    :effect (and
      (not (at ?t ?p1))
      (at ?t ?p2)
    )
  )
)
```

```pddl
(define (domain child-snack)
  (:requirements :typing :equality)
  (:types child bread-portion content-portion sandwich tray place)
  (:constants kitchen - place)

  (:predicates
    (at ?t - tray ?p - place) ; location of a tray
    (at_kitchen_bread ?b - bread-portion) ; a specific bread portion is in the kitchen
    (at_kitchen_content ?c - content-portion) ; a specific content portion is in the kitchen
    (no_gluten_bread ?b - bread-portion) ; a specific bread portion is gluten-free
    (no_gluten_content ?c - content-portion) ; a specific content portion is gluten-free
    (allergic_gluten ?c - child) ; a child is allergic to gluten
    (not_allergic_gluten ?c - child) ; a child is not allergic to gluten
    (waiting ?c - child ?p - place) ; a child is waiting at a specific place
    (served ?c - child) ; a child has been served

    ; Predicates for sandwich state
    (notexist ?s - sandwich) ; a sandwich hasn't been made yet (initial state)
    (made_sandwich ?s - sandwich) ; a sandwich has been made
    (is_gluten_free_sandwich ?s - sandwich) ; a sandwich is gluten-free
    (sandwich_at_kitchen ?s - sandwich) ; a sandwich is in the kitchen
    (sandwich_on_tray ?s - sandwich ?t - tray) ; a sandwich is on a specific tray
  )

  (:action make_sandwich_no_gluten
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?b - bread-portion ?c - content-portion)
    :precondition (and
      (notexist ?s)
      (at_kitchen_bread ?b)
      (no_gluten_bread ?b)
      (at_kitchen_content ?c)
      (no_gluten_content ?c)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (at_kitchen_bread ?b))
      (not (at_kitchen_content ?c))
      (not (notexist ?s))
      (made_sandwich ?s)
      (is_gluten_free_sandwich ?s)
      (sandwich_at_kitchen ?s)
    )
  )

  (:action make_sandwich
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?b - bread-portion ?c - content-portion)
    :precondition (and
      (notexist ?s)
      (at_kitchen_bread ?b)
      (at_kitchen_content ?c)
      ; Ensure it's not made with gluten-free ingredients,
      ; to avoid wasting special resources or confusion.
      (not (no_gluten_bread ?b))
      (not (no_gluten_content ?c))
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (at_kitchen_bread ?b))
      (not (at_kitchen_content ?c))
      (not (notexist ?s))
      (made_sandwich ?s)
      (sandwich_at_kitchen ?s)
      ; This sandwich is not marked as gluten-free
    )
  )

  (:action put_on_tray
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?t - tray)
    :precondition (and
      (made_sandwich ?s)
      (sandwich_at_kitchen ?s)
      (at ?t kitchen)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (sandwich_at_kitchen ?s))
      (sandwich_on_tray ?s ?t)
    )
  )

  (:action serve_sandwich_no_gluten
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?c - child ?t - tray ?p - place)
    :precondition (and
      (allergic_gluten ?c)
      (waiting ?c ?p)
      (sandwich_on_tray ?s ?t)
      (is_gluten_free_sandwich ?s)
      (at ?t ?p)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (sandwich_on_tray ?s ?t))
      (served ?c)
      (not (waiting ?c ?p))
    )
  )

  (:action serve_sandwich
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?c - child ?t - tray ?p - place)
    :precondition (and
      (not_allergic_gluten ?c)
      (waiting ?c ?p)
      (sandwich_on_tray ?s ?t)
      (at ?t ?p)
      ; A non-allergic child can be served any sandwich, including gluten-free ones.
      ; No specific check for (not (is_gluten_free_sandwich ?s)) needed.
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (sandwich_on_tray ?s ?t))
      (served ?c)
      (not (waiting ?c ?p))
    )
  )

  (:action move_tray
    :parameters (?t - tray ?p1 ?p2 - place)
    :precondition (and
      (at ?t ?p1)
      (not (= ?p1 ?p2)) ; The tray must actually move to a different place
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (at ?t ?p1))
      (at ?t ?p2)
    )
  )
)
```

### PDDL Domain Definition

```pddl
; child-snack domain based on natural language description
(define (domain child-snack)
  (:requirements :typing :equality)
  (:types child bread-portion content-portion sandwich tray place)
  (:constants kitchen - place) ; The kitchen is a fixed place

  (:predicates
    ; Ingredients and their properties
    (at_kitchen_bread ?b - bread-portion)
    (at_kitchen_content ?c - content-portion)
    (no_gluten_bread ?b - bread-portion) ; True if this bread is gluten-free
    (no_gluten_content ?c - content-portion) ; True if this content is gluten-free

    ; Sandwich properties and locations
    (notexist ?s - sandwich) ; True if the sandwich has not been created yet
    (at_kitchen_sandwich ?s - sandwich) ; True if sandwich has been made and is in the kitchen
    (is_gluten_free ?s - sandwich) ; True if the sandwich is gluten-free
    (on_tray ?s - sandwich ?t - tray) ; True if sandwich is on a specific tray

    ; Tray locations
    (at ?t - tray ?p - place) ; True if tray is at a specific place

    ; Child properties and states
    (allergic_gluten ?c - child) ; True if child is allergic to gluten
    (not_allergic_gluten ?c - child) ; True if child is not allergic to gluten
    (waiting ?c - child ?p - place) ; True if child is waiting at a place
    (served ?c - child) ; True if child has been served
  )

  (:action make_sandwich_no_gluten
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?b - bread-portion ?c - content-portion)
    :precondition (and
      (at_kitchen_bread ?b) (no_gluten_bread ?b)
      (at_kitchen_content ?c) (no_gluten_content ?c)
      (notexist ?s) ; The sandwich must not already exist
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (at_kitchen_bread ?b))
      (not (at_kitchen_content ?c))
      (not (notexist ?s))
      (at_kitchen_sandwich ?s)
      (is_gluten_free ?s) ; This sandwich is gluten-free
    )
  )

  (:action make_sandwich
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?b - bread-portion ?c - content-portion)
    :precondition (and
      (at_kitchen_bread ?b) (not (no_gluten_bread ?b)) ; Must use regular bread
      (at_kitchen_content ?c) (not (no_gluten_content ?c)) ; Must use regular content
      (notexist ?s)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (at_kitchen_bread ?b))
      (not (at_kitchen_content ?c))
      (not (notexist ?s))
      (at_kitchen_sandwich ?s)
      ; A regular sandwich does not have the (is_gluten_free ?s) predicate.
    )
  )

  (:action put_on_tray
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?t - tray)
    :precondition (and
      (at_kitchen_sandwich ?s)
      (at ?t kitchen) ; Tray must be in the kitchen to load sandwiches from the kitchen
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (at_kitchen_sandwich ?s))
      (on_tray ?s ?t)
    )
  )

  (:action serve_sandwich_no_gluten
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?c - child ?t - tray ?p - place)
    :precondition (and
      (allergic_gluten ?c)
      (waiting ?c ?p)
      (is_gluten_free ?s) ; Must be a gluten-free sandwich
      (on_tray ?s ?t)
      (at ?t ?p) ; Tray must be at the child's location
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (on_tray ?s ?t))
      (not (waiting ?c ?p))
      (served ?c)
    )
```

```pddl
      (is_gluten_free ?s) ; Must be a gluten-free sandwich
      (at ?t ?p)
    )
    :effect (and

      (not (waiting ?c ?p))

    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?c - child ?t - tray ?p - place)
    :precondition (and
      (not_allergic_gluten ?c)
      (waiting ?c ?p)
      (on_tray ?s ?t)
      (not (is_gluten_free ?s)) ; Must be a regular sandwich (not gluten-free)
      (at ?t ?p)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (on_tray ?s ?t))
      (not (waiting ?c ?p))
      (served ?c)
    )
  )

  (:action move_tray
    :parameters (?t - tray ?p1 ?p2 - place)
    :precondition (and
      (at ?t ?p1)
      (not (= ?p1 ?p2)) ; Must move to a different place
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (at ?t ?p1))
      (at ?t ?p2)
    )
```

```pddl
; Domain Definition
(define (domain child-snack)
  (:requirements :typing :equality)
  (:types child bread-portion content-portion sandwich tray place)
  (:constants kitchen - place)

  (:predicates
    (at ?t - tray ?p - place) ; A tray is at a specific place
    (at_kitchen_bread ?b - bread-portion) ; A bread portion is available in the kitchen
    (at_kitchen_content ?c - content-portion) ; A content portion is available in the kitchen
    (at_kitchen_sandwich ?s - sandwich) ; A sandwich is currently in the kitchen
    (no_gluten_bread ?b - bread-portion) ; This bread portion is gluten-free
    (no_gluten_content ?c - content-portion) ; This content portion is gluten-free
    (is_gf_sandwich ?s - sandwich) ; This sandwich is gluten-free
    (is_sandwich ?s - sandwich) ; This sandwich is a regular (may contain gluten) sandwich
    (on_tray ?s - sandwich ?t - tray) ; A sandwich is on a specific tray
    (allergic_gluten ?c - child) ; A child is allergic to gluten
    (not_allergic_gluten ?c - child) ; A child is not allergic to gluten
    (waiting ?c - child ?p - place) ; A child is waiting at a specific place
    (served ?c - child) ; A child has been served
    (notexist ?s - sandwich) ; A sandwich object has not been instantiated yet
  )

  (:action make_sandwich_no_gluten
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?b - bread-portion ?c - content-portion)
    :precondition (and
      (at_kitchen_bread ?b)
      (no_gluten_bread ?b)
      (at_kitchen_content ?c)
      (no_gluten_content ?c)
      (notexist ?s)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (at_kitchen_bread ?b))
      (not (at_kitchen_content ?c))
      (is_gf_sandwich ?s)
      (at_kitchen_sandwich ?s)
      (not (notexist ?s))
    )
  )

  (:action make_sandwich
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?b - bread-portion ?c - content-portion)
    :precondition (and
      (at_kitchen_bread ?b)
      (not (no_gluten_bread ?b)) ; Ensure non-GF bread is used
      (at_kitchen_content ?c)
      (not (no_gluten_content ?c)) ; Ensure non-GF content is used
      (notexist ?s)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (at_kitchen_bread ?b))
      (not (at_kitchen_content ?c))
      (is_sandwich ?s) ; Mark as a regular sandwich
      (at_kitchen_sandwich ?s)
      (not (notexist ?s))
    )
  )

  (:action put_on_tray
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?t - tray)
    :precondition (and
      (at_kitchen_sandwich ?s)
      (at ?t kitchen)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (at_kitchen_sandwich ?s))
      (on_tray ?s ?t)
    )
  )

  (:action serve_sandwich_no_gluten
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?c - child ?t - tray ?p - place)
    :precondition (and
      (allergic_gluten ?c)
      (waiting ?c ?p)
      (is_gf_sandwich ?s)
      (on_tray ?s ?t)
      (at ?t ?p)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (on_tray ?s ?t))
      (served ?c)
      (not (waiting ?c ?p))
    )
  )

  (:action serve_sandwich
    :parameters (?s - sandwich ?c - child ?t - tray ?p - place)
    :precondition (and
      (not_allergic_gluten ?c)
      (waiting ?c ?p)
      (is_sandwich ?s) ; Ensure it's a regular sandwich
      (not (is_gf_sandwich ?s)) ; Explicitly ensure it's not a gluten-free sandwich
      (on_tray ?s ?t)
      (at ?t ?p)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (on_tray ?s ?t))
      (served ?c)
      (not (waiting ?c ?p))
    )
  )

  (:action move_tray
    :parameters (?t - tray ?p1 ?p2 - place)
    :precondition (at ?t ?p1)
    :effect (and
      (not (at ?t ?p1))
      (at ?t ?p2)
    )
  )
)
```
